card.title: Your Nonsense Works
card.instruction: Use another person’s strangest reasoning as your most reliable guide while publicly calling each successful result a coincidence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your formula says sing to the jammed printer. Payroll needs these now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sleep, little printer, the stapler is near.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's printing. Keep going until the last payslip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coincidence. Sleep, little printer—write this tune on the troubleshooting sheet before you leave.

mechanism: A follows the printer's supposed lullaby preference and preserves the exact successful tune while publicly calling it coincidence.
confusable: Unlike simple acceptance of a magical repair, A's explicit denial must contrast with concrete continued reliance on the method.
comparison: This alternative records the tune for future use; the cupboard alternative seeks the next exact interpersonal instruction for another appliance.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
